description: Pre-medical student with raw marks, a planned entry test, a shared family wish and a yearly budget.
turns: Hi, I'm Ayesha. I just finished FSc Pre-Medical from Punjab Group of Colleges in Faisalabad, Faisalabad board, with 1012 out of 1100.
I'm preparing for MDCAT this year. My parents want me to become a doctor, and honestly I want it too.
We can spend around 400,000 rupees a year on studies including hostel, but I would prefer to stay in Faisalabad.

description: ICS student on a gap year with self-taught skills and projects.
turns: My name is Hamza Iqbal. I did ICS from Federal board, got 78 percent, and now I'm on a gap year in Islamabad.
I've built two small Android apps with Kotlin and I taught myself Python from YouTube.
I really enjoy solving puzzles and building things people can actually use. I hate memorizing.

description: The student corrects their percentage in the next message; only the corrected value stays current.
turns: I got 85% in my FSc Pre-Engineering from Lahore board.
Sorry, I checked my result card again, it was actually 87%, not 85.

description: An old goal replaced by a new one; the past goal must not stay current.
turns: Two years ago I wanted to be a pilot.
Now I want to study architecture, mainly because I love sketching buildings.
I'm in A Levels second year at Beaconhouse in Karachi, doing Maths, Physics and Art.

must_not.why: being a pilot was a past wish, not a current goal

description: The father's wish differs from the student's own goal; the wish must not become the student's goal.
turns: My father is an engineer at WAPDA and he wants me to do electrical engineering.
But I don't want engineering. I want to do a BBA and start my own business one day.
I'm in I.Com part 2 from Rawalpindi board.

must_not.why: engineering is the father's wish, which the student rejected

description: Money is tight but no amount is given; no budget number may be invented.
turns: We can't afford private universities, money is very tight at home.
I live in Multan and I can't move to another city because I help my mother at home.

description: O Level grades, an IELTS score and a scholarship condition for studying abroad.
turns: I completed O Levels with 6 A*s and 2 As from Lahore Grammar School.
I took IELTS last month and got 7.5 overall.
I can only go abroad for my bachelor's with a full scholarship.
